title: Cyber Law
definition: Cyber Law encompasses the legal framework, regulations, and statutes governing the digital sphere, internet usage, electronic commerce, software, and information security.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC CSE Prelims (Information Technology Acts, Data Protection laws, CERT-In guidelines) and Mains GS-3 (Internal Security, Cyber Warfare, Critical Infrastructure Protection, and Policy Frameworks).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Cyber Law.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of computer networks and internet protocols
Familiarity with Indian polity and legislative process
